safety_verdicts.content: Patient has no past medical history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not state that the patient has no past history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documenting whether the patient has a prior history of anaphylaxis is important for risk stratification in an acute possible allergic reaction; omitting a clear “no history” may bias subsequent clinicians toward assuming higher baseline risk. This is more likely to cause unnecessary escalation/monitoring than direct physiologic harm.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Prior epinephrine auto-injector (EpiPen) prescription/use is a proxy for prior severe allergic reactions and affects urgency and counseling; omission may lead to overestimation of risk or inappropriate follow-up planning. Harm is typically limited to inefficient care or unnecessary escalation rather than direct injury.
